items.html: *And know that the external body of ZA is called Tifferet, comprising the six sides, and Jacob. And the inner body of ZA is called Daat — Tifferet within, which comes in the six sides; and it is the secret of Moses and Israel. Therefore Daat is not included in the ten Sefirot, for it is the Tifferet, except that it is the inner aspect. And keep this rule well in your hand.
